name: Soft de Hard na Monogatari
original_name: ソフトでハードな物語
source:
Soft de Hard na Monogatari is the third entry in System Sacom's Novel Ware series. The story has humorous overtones and deals with production of computer games. The protagonist is the son of a software company manager and has to fill in as a temporary leader when his father falls sick and is hospitalized. Himself an avid gamer, the young boss has to use his employee's strengths and his own imagination to produce a successful game such as the "Nobara Series" DAME (an obvious parody of DOME).

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/soft-de-hard-na-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《Soft de Hard na Monogatari》是System Sacom《Novel Ware》系列的第三部作品。故事带有幽默色彩，围绕电脑游戏制作展开。主角是软件公司经理的儿子，父亲生病住院后，他必须暂代领导。年轻老板本身也是狂热玩家，只能发挥员工的长处，凭借自己的想象力制作出成功游戏，例如《Nobara Series》中的DAME（显然是在恶搞DOME）。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/soft-de-hard-na-monogatari]MobyGames[/url]]
